PASS_iff_all.P0: ≥ 3 qualifying traverse sequences AND ≥ 90 % of traverse frames with a PLACES position (otherwise FAIL: the claim cannot be demonstrated)
PASS_iff_all.P3: largest distance from any archived frame to its nearest kept frame ≤ 10 m in every qualifying sequence
PASS_iff_all.P5: Scheduler V3 monotonic and stereo-safe (see scheduler_v3.monotonicity)

primary.no_rescue: 1/2 and 1/8 are context only; no other operating point, metric or method may replace a failed primary

secondary.question: Does POSITION + EMBEDDING_CHANGE provide ≥ 0.020 absolute visual-change gain over POSITION at 1/4 retention without reducing 5 m coverage by more than 0.01?
secondary.MEANINGFUL ADDED VALUE: gain ≥ 0.020 AND 95 % lower bound > 0 AND coverage difference ≥ −0.01
secondary.HARMFUL: coverage difference < −0.01, OR gain ≤ −0.020 with 95 % upper bound < 0
secondary.role: does not affect the primary PASS/FAIL
